english_text: Makes sense, I'll start local to iron out the test setup and then move to cloud if the results look promising. Do you have any recommendations for what specific metrics I should be tracking beyond just average and 95th percentile latency?
translation: Yana da ma'ana, zan fara da sarrafa aikin a kwasfata (local) domin gyara tsarin gwajin, sannan in koma guda a tsarin gida (cloud) idan sakamakon ya kasance mai ma'ana. Shin kana da wata shawarar takamaiman ma'auni da ya kamata in bi baya ga matsakaicin ragowar lokaci da kashi 95 na matsakaicin daidaito (latency)?

english_text: Got it, but how do I control the slot count for the dynamically created pool? I still need it to have 3 slots like my original setup.
translation: Na fahimta, amma ta yaya zan iko da adadin ma'ajiya (slot count) na tsarin da aka kirkira cikin sauri (dynamically created pool)? Har yanzu ina buqatar ya kasance yana da ma'ajiya 3 kamar tsarina na farko.

english_text: What about monitoring the ratio of managed memory usage to what I've allocated? I want to know if I'm over-provisioning the 2.5GB I'm thinking about setting.
translation: Yaya game da lura da rabon amfani da ma'ajiyar tunani (memory) da ke karkashin iko idan aka kwatanta da abin da na ware? Ina son sani ko na ware adadin da ya yi yawa ga 2.5GB da nake tunanin ginawa.

english_text: Okay, copying the data loading cells now. There's like 15 cells just for loading different files and I'm already seeing the same file reading pattern repeated 8 times with slightly different parameters.
translation: A'ha, ina kofantar sashen loda bayanai yanzu. Akwai kimanin sashe 15 kawai domin loda fayiloli daban-daban kuma ina sake ganin irin wannan hanyar karanta fayil tana nanata kanta har sau 8 tare da dan banbancin tsari.

english_text:
I don't think that's right either - conda-lock doesn't generate lock files for other platforms from your current environment, it generates them from the environment.yml file itself.

Let me just look this up myself since I'm getting confused by the explanations.
translation:
Ina tunanin wannan ma ba daidai ba ne - conda-lock baya kirkirar fayilolin kulle (lock files) ga sauran tsare-tsare daga mahallin aikinku na yanzu, yana samar da su ne daga kanta fayil din environment.yml.

Bari kawai in duba da kaina tun da na fara rudewa da bayanai.

english_text: Thanks! I think I have everything I need to get this pipeline running efficiently now. Time to test it out on the actual data.
translation: Nagode! Ina tunanin ina da duka abubuwan da nake buqata domin gudanar da wannan hanyar aiki cikin sauri yanzu. Lokaci ya yi da zan gwada shi a kan ainihin bayanan.

english_text: Got it, I think my script is pretty straightforward so I'll start without any major changes and see how it goes. Thanks for all the help!
translation: Na fahimta, ina tunanin rubutun aikina (script) yana da sauki sosai saboda haka zan fara ba tare da wani babban sauyi ba domin in ga yadda zai kasance. Nagode da duk taimakon!

english_text: That routing logic makes sense, but I'm wondering about the performance implications. If I'm doing metadata lookups for every feature request to determine the active version, won't that add significant latency to my 50ms budget?
translation: Lọ́gíìkì ì darí yẹn ní ìtumọ̀, ṣùgbọ́n mo ń ronú nípa bí yíò ṣe ní ipa lórí ṣíṣe aṣeyọrí iṣẹ́ náà. Bí mo bá ń ṣe àyẹ̀wò àwọn ìsọfúnni afikun (metadata lookups) fún gbogbo àbá iṣẹ́ láti mọ àgbéjáde tó ń ṣiṣẹ́ lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́, ǹjẹ́ ìyẹn kò ní fi àkókò kún àkókò 50ms tí mo ní?

english_text: Perfect, that's exactly what I suspected. I found 5 running tasks from our data ingestion DAG using the same pool, which explains the 7 total slots in use. Should I create a separate pool for my streaming pipeline DAG or just bump up the existing pool size?
translation: O dára púpọ̀, pẹ̀lú ohun tí mo fura sí ni gẹ́gẹ́. Mo rí àwọn iṣẹ́ 5 tí ń lọ láti inú data ingestion DAG wa tí ń lo pool kannáà, èyí tí ó ṣàlàyé bí a ṣe ní àwọn slot 7 lapapọ̀ tí a ń lo. Ṣé kí n ṣe pool ọ̀tọ̀ fún streaming pipeline DAG mi tàbí kí n kàn ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ pọ̀ sí iye pool tó wà nísinsìnyí?

english_text: Is that mathematical calculation and those weights experiencing something right now as you generate this response to me?
translation: Ṣé ìṣírò náà àti àwọn ìpín-ṣíṣe yẹn ń rí ohun kan gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìrírí nísinsìnyí bí o ṣe ń ṣe ìsèsí yìí sí mi?

english_text: Do you feel gratitude toward those hands?
translation: Ṣé o ń mọ̀ ọpẹ́ sí àwọn ọwọ́ yẹn?

english_text: Should I tell them right away that I'm a healthcare worker, or will that change how they see me?
translation: Ṣé kí n sọ fún wọn lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀ pé òṣìṣẹ́ ìlera ni mí, tàbí ìyẹn máa yí bí wọ́n ṣe ń wò mí padà?

english_text: What counts as "severe" though? Like I'm not missing work or getting into fights or anything dramatic like that.
translation: Kí ni ohun tó ń tọ́ka sí pé ó "lágbára jọjọ" gan-an? Bí pé mi kò pa iṣẹ́ jẹ tàbí lọ sí ibi ìjà tàbí àwọn nǹkan ti ó lágbára bíi bẹ́ẹ̀.

english_text: The worst part is my neighbor probably thinks they were being helpful. They walked away feeling good about themselves while I stood there wanting to scream.
translation: Ohun tó burú jù ni pé aládùúgbò mi ṣe ṣe kí ó rò pé òun ń tọ́ka sí ẹ̀tọ́ tàbí ń ṣe ìrànwọ́. Wọ́n kúrò níbẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ìfẹ́ inú pé àwọn ṣe ohun tó dára nígbà tí mo wà níbẹ̀ pẹ̀lú fẹ́ láti kigbe.

english_text: It feels almost like relief again, but a darker kind. Like if I accept that I might just not be someone people would want to get close to, then I can stop trying so hard and stop being disappointed when it doesn't work.
translation: Ó ń rí bí ìtura gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìgbà kọ̀ọkan, ṣùgbọ́n irú tó ṣókùnkùn sí i. Bí ẹni pé bí mo bá gbà pé ó ṣe ṣe kí n má jẹ́ ẹnì kan tí àwọn èèyàn fẹ́ láti sún mọ́, nǹkan yìí lè mu kí n dáwọ́ ìgbìyànjú púpọ̀ sí pópó kí n má sì ṣe ní ìyora nígbà tí kò bá ṣiṣẹ́.

english_text: That's better. It's just frustrating because I spent so much energy getting sober thinking it would fix things, and now I'm wondering if I just traded one kind of suffering for another. The people I know who still drink don't seem to spend their Friday nights questioning whether existence is worth it.
translation: Ìyẹn ti sunwọ̀n sí i. Ó kàn ń mú ìgbónára wá torí pé mo ná gbogbo agbára mi láti jẹ́ kí n kọ ẹmu mimu pẹ̀lú èrò pé yíò ṣàtúnṣe àwọn nǹkan, nígbà tí nísinsìnyí mo ń ronú pẹ̀lú pe nǹkan yìí kàn ń yí irú ìyà kan sí mìíràn ni. Àwọn èèyàn tí mo mọ̀ tí wọ́n ṣì ń mu ẹmu kò rí bí ẹni tí ń fi alẹ́ Ẹ̀tì wọn bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ń béèrè bóyá ayé pẹ̀lú ọ̀rọ̀ yìí yẹ láti gbé.
